title: Hover on an Effeck form crashes the language server
author: smithers-agent
head: fix/hover-forms
body:
Fixes #31.

Hover over the provide or catch word in an Effeck file. The language server stops answering.

Expected: a hover describing the form, followed by the declaration documentation.

Reproduce with the service example in the welcome guide.

maya reviewed the regression and landed this source patch.

reviews.author: maya
reviews.body: Checked the regression and generated types.

reviewComments.author: maya
reviewComments.body: Keep the source-token walk independent of child order. The concurrent binding and items need their own parameter types.

checks.name: Source checks
checks.detail: Synthesized execution of this source change’s checks.

lines.text: // Effeck (.effeck) forms parse into the TypeScript nodes they abbreviate
// (parser/effeck.go), and the nodes a form synthesizes carry
// NodeFlagsReparsed, so this package's walk skips them. Two things then leave
// a source token where getTokenAtPosition expects only trivia between a node's
//   - The word that names a form, such as error, match, when, join, or the all
//     of await.all, is an identifier with no node of its own.
//   - A desugared node can hold source children out of source order, or
//     outside its own range, so a binary search by position misses them:
//     for concurrent(8) (const id of ids) passes ids before 8, and its body
//     function starts after the binding id.
// TypeScript code has neither, so outside .effeck files an identifier in
// effeckSourceToken returns the source node that is exactly the token at
// [start, end), found below current or else below its nearest ancestor that
// holds it, or nil. A desugared node can range over a sibling's source child,
// as the body function of for concurrent ranges over its items, so the walk
// can stop below the node that holds the token. It visits every child in
// order rather than searching by position, and never descends into a
// synthesized node, so the node it returns has only source nodes above it.
func effeckSourceToken(sourceFile *ast.SourceFile, current *ast.Node, start int, end int) *ast.Node {
if node.End() == end && scanner.GetTokenPosOfNode(node, sourceFile, false /*includeJSDoc*/) == start && ast.IsTokenKind(node.Kind) {
for scope := current; scope != nil && found == nil; scope = scope.Parent {
// effeckWordNode returns the node that stands for the word of an Effeck form
// at the scanner's current token, where no source node covers it. The word
// of a declaration that parses into a class, error, service, control, or the
// older layer, is that class's class keyword, and the word of one that parses
// into a const, schema or layer, is its const keyword, so the language
// service treats each as TypeScript treats those keywords: rename and go to
// definition move to the declared name. Any other word stands for the form

title: Keep golden cases out of the converter prompt
author: smithers-agent
head: converter/heldout-gate
body:
Fixes #32.

The prompt builder reads the cases used to score conversion. Use ten separate example pairs and reject normalized copies of held-out input or output, including copies inside larger blocks.

This follow-up review shows the related source patch. The follow-up branch has no landed commit yet.

title: Repack skipped platform optional dependencies
author: smithers-agent
head: release/optional-packages
body:
Fixes #34.

A clean npm ci after scaffolding can install a lockfile without the platform compiler. Repack the tarball, check payloads and permissions, then install from the generated lockfile.

This follow-up review shows the related source patch. The follow-up branch has no landed commit yet.

import { lstatSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, readlinkSync, renameSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"

for (const name of removed) delete pkg.optionalDependencies[name]
if (packed.name !== pkg.name || packed.version !== pkg.version || packed.filename !== entry.file) {
throw new Error("repack: npm pack changed the package identity")

title: Do not deploy docs that fail on the released compiler
author: smithers-agent
head: docs/release-snippets
body:
Fixes #37.

Compile guide snippets with compiler and runtime release tarballs. The checkout compiler can accept syntax users cannot install.

maya reviewed the regression and landed this source patch.

reviews.author: maya
reviews.body: Checked the regression and generated types.

checks.name: Source checks
checks.detail: Synthesized execution of this source change’s checks.

lines.text: # Until 0.0.2 ships, every docs example must compile with the release that
# `npm create effeck@latest` installs: the 0.0.1 native compiler and runtime
# from the release tarballs, not this checkout's build.
# EFFECK_SKIP_RELEASE_SNIPPETS=1 skips the check, and needs
echo "deploy-docs: skipping the $release release snippet check: ${EFFECK_SKIP_RELEASE_SNIPPETS_REASON:?deploy-docs: set EFFECK_SKIP_RELEASE_SNIPPETS_REASON to say why}"
*) echo "deploy-docs: no $release release compiler for $(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
# As an npm install puts effect beside effeck-runtime, give the extracted runtime
# the repository's pinned effect, so its declarations resolve their imports.
echo "deploy-docs: compiling every docs example with effeck $release ($platform) and effeck-runtime $release"
{ tail -40 "$release_dir/snippets.log" >&2; echo "deploy-docs: a docs example does not compile with the $release release" >&2; exit 1; }
